# options

```go
import "github.com/c2fo/vfs/v7/options"
```

Package options provides a set of interfaces and functions to define and apply options for file systems.

Options are grouped by the operation they apply to:

- NewFileSystemOption configures a backend's FileSystem through its NewFileSystem function. Each backend provides its own options, such as s3.WithOptions or gs.WithRetryer.
- NewFileOption configures FileSystem.NewFile and Location.NewFile. See the options/newfile package, for example newfile.WithContentType.
- DeleteOption configures File.Delete and Location.DeleteFile. See the options/delete package, for example delete.WithAllVersions.
- ListOption configures listing through vfs.EntryLister. See the list package, for example list.Recursive.

### Creating a Custom Option

To create your own option, define a type that implements the relevant interface. For example, a DeleteOption:

```
type TakeBackupDeleteOption struct {
    backupLocation string
}

func (o TakeBackupDeleteOption) DeleteOptionName() string {
    return "take-backup"
}

func (o TakeBackupDeleteOption) BackupLocation() string {
    return o.backupLocation
}
```

Then, in each backend implementation that should support it, handle the option in Delete:

```
func (f *File) Delete(opts ...options.DeleteOption) error {
    for _, o := range opts {
        switch o := o.(type) {
        case delete.AllVersions:
            // delete all versions
        case TakeBackupDeleteOption:
            // copy the file to o.BackupLocation() before deleting
        default:
        }
    }
    ...
}
```

<a name="ApplyOptions"></a>
## func ApplyOptions

```go
func ApplyOptions[T any](fs *T, opts ...NewFileSystemOption[T])
```

ApplyOptions is a helper to apply multiple options in a single call.

<a name="DeleteOption"></a>
## type DeleteOption

DeleteOption interface contains function that should be implemented by any custom option to qualify as a delete option. See the package documentation for an example.

```go
type DeleteOption interface {
    DeleteOptionName() string
}
```

<a name="ListOption"></a>
## type ListOption

ListOption interface contains function that should be implemented by any custom option to qualify as a list option. List options configure listing through vfs.EntryLister and the list package, for example list.Recursive.

```go
type ListOption interface {
    ListOptionName() string
}
```

<a name="NewFileOption"></a>
## type NewFileOption

NewFileOption interface contains function that should be implemented by any custom option to qualify as a new file option.

```go
type NewFileOption interface {
    NewFileOptionName() string
}
```

<a name="NewFileSystemOption"></a>
## type NewFileSystemOption

NewFileSystemOption interface contains function that should be implemented by any custom option to qualify as a new file system option.

```go
type NewFileSystemOption[T any] interface {
    NewFileSystemOptionName() string
    // contains filtered or unexported methods
}
```

<a name="Option"></a>
## type Option

Option interface contains function that should be implemented by any custom option.

```go
type Option[T any] interface {
    Apply(*T)
}
```
